title: 归因消融：四格 × 三主效应，Holm 校正

config.scope: internal component attribution, not external validation

notes: SCOPE: this is INTERNAL COMPONENT ATTRIBUTION, not external generalisation validation. Every cell uses a fixed configuration over all 2,000 questions of one benchmark that this project has already used to choose its methods. The intervals say how reliably each component moves recall HERE; they say nothing about a new corpus, and they do not re-earn the out-of-fold claim, which only nested_cv.py's document-grouped protocol supports.
Holm family = 12 tests (4 cells x 3 main effects). Raw intervals are recorded alongside so the correction hides nothing.
